claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM nocodazole binds the colchicine site of beta-tubulin and depolymerizes microtubules, causing spindle assembly checkpoint arrest in prometaphase and mitotic catastrophe/apoptosis in proliferating cells, so killing is a broad antimitotic class effect rather than HPGDS inhibition.
